method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Veterans' Entitlements Act 1986, Compilation No. 199, compilation date 1 July 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 17, 2025 and Act No. 31, 2026 (register id C2026C00275, in 4 volumes), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A03268.txt. In vea-veteran.l4 no instrument is brought in: the indexed pension rates, the Approved Guide ratings and the s 37AA determination are inputs or facts. vea-guide.l4 (from 2026-10-24) reads the Guide to the Assessment of Rates of Veterans' Pensions (No. 2) 2016 (F2016L01332; Table 23.1 from F2016L01332.tables.md) and the Veterans' Entitlements (Invalidity Service Pension - Permanent Incapacity for Work) Determination 2023 (F2023L01239), both retrieved 2026-10-23; the indexed rates are still inputs. Added 2026-10-24: the s 198(5DA), (5E), (8A) and s 59LA(1) formulas from the sidecar ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A03268.formulas.md, read by vea-formulas.l4; the MBR amounts and CPI numbers are inputs.

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run vea-veteran.l4 ; l4 run vea-cases-veteran.l4 ; l4 run vea-guide.l4 ; l4 run vea-cases-guide.l4 ; l4 run vea-formulas.l4 ; l4 run vea-cases-formulas.l4
checks.result: 111 assertions written, 111 satisfied (65 + 25 + 21), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); the modules check with no errors or warnings
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the veteran's seat (and the widow's or widower's for ss 13A, 30(1)): s 12AA (no new Part II, Part IV or s 111 claims from 1 July 2026); s 9A (injury or death under the MRCA, not the VEA); s 5QA (a veteran's pension age); s 7A(1)(a) (qualifying service, paragraphs (b)-(h) as one fact); ss 36(1)-(3), 37(1), (3)-(5) (eligibility for age and invalidity service pension, with the residence rule for Commonwealth and allied veterans); s 36B(1)-(2) (provisional commencement day); ss 22(2)-(4), 23(1)-(4), (3A), 24(1)-(4), (2A) (which rate of disability pension, and how much, the rates in force as inputs); ss 13A(1), (2), 30(1) (the war widow's or widower's pension without a claim, and its rate); s 54(5), (5A) (the period to report a change); ss 57, 57A, 135(5), 175(2) (review). Out: the service pension rate (Schedule 6 Rate Calculator, income and assets tests); partner service pension, income support supplement, veteran payment, pension bonus; ss 23(5)-(6), 24(5)-(6), 25, 25A, 26, 27, 115D; compensation offsets; the dependant child rate; Parts IV-VIA; the Veterans' Review Board's procedure (MRCA Chapter 8); information, offences and machinery. In since 2026-10-24 (vea-guide.l4): the Approved Guide's rounding of the combined impairment rating and Table 23.1 (degree of incapacity); the s 37AA Determination 2023 ss 6, 7 (permanent incapacity for work); the ss 22-24 rate and s 37 eligibility asked from them. Rates in force still inputs. Added 2026-10-24 (vea-formulas.l4): ss 59LA(1), (2A) pension MBR factor, 198(5DA), (5E), (8A) MBR indexation of the general, above general and s 30(1)(b) rates, 198(4), (5) CPI indexation of relevant rates (s 30(1)(c)), and the disability and war widow's pension questions on the indexed rates.
seat: the veteran; and, for ss 13A and 30(1), the veteran's widow or widower
